runs.t: Factory-built power infrastructure for mission-critical facilities.

Prefabricated generator enclosures and power buildings — engineered to complement the complete AccelCore™ data center structural package, delivering faster electrical infrastructure and greater predictability on complex campus programs.

AccelGen™ brings the same factory-built efficiency of AccelCore™ and AccelDeck™ to the electrical infrastructure side of data center delivery — generator enclosures, power distribution buildings, and switchgear rooms fabricated off-site and coordinated with the structural package.

By building generator enclosures and power buildings in the factory, Clark Pacific eliminates the field coordination challenges that typically arise between structural concrete, MEP contractors, and electrical infrastructure — delivering a single-source solution for the entire campus shell.
AccelGen™ is coordinated with the AccelCore™ structural grid, AccelDeck™ mechanical platform, and AccelShell™ enclosure system — so all components arrive as a cohesive, pre-engineered package.

runs.t: One team responsible for generator enclosures, power buildings, structural shell, mechanical platform, and wall panels — from design through warranty.
Schedule compression when AccelGen™ is coordinated with AccelCore™ and AccelDeck™
One team, one contract — structural shell and power infrastructure coordinated together
Generator enclosures and power rooms fabricated in controlled conditions — not field-built steel
Full structural precast system — shell, floor systems, enclosure, and embeds.
Insulated wall panels — cladding or load-bearing, with 100+ finish options and R-15 to R-25 thermal range.
Prefabricated elevated chiller support system — 4–8 weeks of additional schedule savings.
Prefabricated power buildings — generator rooms and electrical infrastructure built in the factory.
AccelGen™ is most effective when coordinated early with the structural package. Talk to our team about integrating power infrastructure into your prefabricated data center plan.
Clark Pacific is a leading manufacturer of prefabricated building systems. We are transforming design and construction by delivering high-quality, cost-effective buildings with less risk.
